purpose: Version the component-only terminology correction required before V38 feature extraction without mutating the sealed V2 feature protocol.

terminology.replacementDefinition: eventStartCount / activeBarCount for a selected directional component output; null when activeBarCount is zero.
terminology.runtimeFreshnessUnavailableReason: The exact V38 fresh_event guard belongs to the frozen graph/event runtime. This component-only canary may calculate indicator and event projections but may not execute the graph, state machine, or entry guards.

canaryBinding.selectionMethod: first frozen task in the exact V38 panel-3/year-1-q3 screening task file; task order is the sole selection rule

activityProjection.activeDefinition: The selected directional score is active exactly when score > 1e-9.
activityProjection.eventStartDefinition: For each direction independently, an active completed bar is an event start when the preceding completed bar is inactive; the first completed bar is a start when active.
activityProjection.featureClock: M5 completed_bar; calculate from the isolated lookback-inclusive window and report features only on the frozen analysis interval.
